title: Record-breaking people
text: The Guinness Book of Records is a famous book. It has thousands of world records. Every year, people try to break records and get their names in the book.
Robert Wadlow is the tallest man in history. He was two meters and seventy-two centimeters tall. His shoes were very, very big!
Some people have very long hair or very long nails. One woman from the United States had nails of more than seven meters! Other people have many tattoos on their bodies.
Some records are about speed. Usain Bolt from Jamaica is the fastest man in the world. He can run one hundred meters in nine seconds and fifty-eight hundredths.
Children can also have records. Some kids are very young chess champions, and some kids are the youngest pilots or scientists. What record do you want to break?
q: What is the Guinness Book of Records?
A famous book with world records
Who is the tallest man in history?

grammar.title: Grammar: plurals
grammar.rule: Most nouns add -s in the plural. Nouns ending in -s, -sh, -ch or -x add -es. Some plurals are irregular.
items: Two tall ___ were in the photo.
